title: Marketplace listing impact study: channel signals & procurement conversion
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Objective:
Run a focused research and product experiment to measure whether third-party marketplace listings (cloud marketplaces, partner catalogs, and model hub entries) materially change procurement conversion rates, latency/region preference, and regional capacity signals for Redwood customers.

Why this matters:
- Marketplace listings are an emerging channel for enterprise procurement. Anecdotally, channel exposure shifts buyer inertia; we need quantitative signals to prioritize integrations and marketplace partnerships.
- If listings bias customers toward particular model providers, that impacts our model-sourcing strategy, Dedicated capacity commitments, and routing policies.

Scope / what we'll deliver:
1) Define a Marketplace Impact Score (MIS) that combines: listing presence, featured placement, readme/benchmark quality, downloadable model artifacts, and channel referral traffic.
2) Ingest channel, referral & procurement telemetry (sales leads tagged from marketplace, trial signups, region of origin, initial API model selection) for the last 12 months.
3) Build an analysis notebook and a lightweight dashboard in Console showing: MIS by provider, conversion lift over baseline, region-weighted latency preference shifts, and correlation with capacity reservations (Dedicated signups).
4) Run 4 short experiments with partner listings where we vary messaging (performance-first vs cost-first) and measure conversion lift and change in model selection within trial accounts.
5) Produce a go/no-go recommendation for prioritizing 3 marketplace partnerships and a set of product asks (integration patterns, model-level badges, marketplace analytics hooks).

Methodology notes:
- Signals to join: UTM/referrer, sales CRM tags, trial->paid conversion, initial model chosen in first 7 days, region/IP geolocation, billing plan chosen (hosted vs dedicated), latency/throughput breakpoint if available.
- Compute MIS as a weighted z-score across normalized signals; keep weights configurable in experiment config.
- Use propensity matching to control for customer segment (SMB vs enterprise) and known marketing campaigns.

Deliverables and artifacts:
- analysis/notebooks/marketplace_mis_v1.ipynb (link to Drive will be added)
- console/dashboard:marketplace-impact-v1 (prototype)
- short PRD (Confluence) with recommended product changes and partner contract template
- experiment logs & final recommendation memo (2 pages)
acceptance_criteria: Data ingestion: referral/UTM + CRM marketplace tags + trial telemetry available for >70% of last 12 months
MIS implemented in analysis notebook and sanity-checked against two providers
Dashboard prototype shows MIS, conversion lift, regional preference, and Dedicated signup correlation
Run at least 2 controlled listing-message experiments with partners and record conversion delta with statistical confidence >80%
Recommendation memo includes prioritized partner list and 3 product/analytics asks with estimated engineering effort
